environment.description: Terraform provider API deployed on a single EC2 instance (t3.medium) running Go binary directly. PostgreSQL 14 on RDS with standard configuration. Database role used by the application is 'tfprovider_app' which has full SELECT/INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE on all tables in the 'public' schema. No row-level security policies are enabled. The API is exposed via an NLB with TLS termination. SameSite cookie attribute is set to 'None' for cross-origin Terraform CLI compatibility. No CSRF middleware is configured.

config.db_role: tfprovider_app (superuser: false, full DML on public schema)
config.network: NLB with TLS passthrough, no WAF
